item.title: Employers encouraged to register for NMC’s Career Fair in March
item.description: (NMC) — Northern Marianas College is inviting all local employers, government agencies, and business organizations to participate in its upcoming Career Fair on Friday, March 13, 2026. The event offers a valuable opportunity for employers to meet with NMC students, recent graduates, and community members who are eager to join the workforce. The post Employers encouraged to register for NMC’s Career Fair in March appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Saipan Chamber supports labor stabilization bill
item.description: (SCC) — The Saipan Chamber of Commerce expresses its strong support for the Northern Mariana Islands Labor Stabilization Act, a bill that would provide long-term workforce stability while reinforcing protections for U.S. workers in the Commonwealth. The post Saipan Chamber supports labor stabilization bill appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Acting Gov. Mendiola meets with US Air Force leadership
item.description: (Office of the CNMI Governor) — Acting Gov. Dennis James C. Mendiola met with Maj. Gen. Thomas M. Sherman, commander of the Air Force Installation and Mission Support Center, along with other senior military leaders, to engage in discussions aimed at strengthening collaboration and enhancing a mutually beneficial partnership between the ongoing military buildup and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands. item.title: Governor continues 902 consultations in Washington
item.description: (Office of the CNMI Governor) — On Tuesday, Gov. David M. Apatang and his Section 902 Consultations Team continued negotiations with the federal government in Washington D.C., underscoring the need for immediate federal regulatory changes and financial support amid the Commonwealth’s fiscal crisis. The post Governor continues 902 consultations in Washington appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: CNMI needs a hand up, not a handout
item.description: IMMEDIATE administrative action to stabilize the workforce can reduce uncertainty in the CNMI economy, Gov. David M. Apatang said in his testimony before the Department of the Interior’s Interagency Group on Insular Affairs in Washington, D.C., on Thursday, Saipan time. item.title: BOE tables most agenda items after islandwide power outage
item.description: THE Board of Education was scheduled to discuss, among other critical matters, a possible issue concerning the CNMI Supreme Court’s interpretation of the constitutionally mandated 25% allocation of government funds to the Public School System, during a special meeting on Capital Hill at 9 a.m. Thursday. item.title: Islandwide outage hits Saipan again
item.description: SAIPAN experienced another islandwide power outage Thursday morning at around 7:12 a.m., which lasted about four hours. item.title: MVA: January arrivals down 16%
item.description: (MVA) — The Marianas Visitors Authority reports that visitor arrivals to the CNMI totaled 14,828 in January 2026, a 16% decrease compared to 17,744 visitors in January 2025. The post MVA: January arrivals down 16% appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: US Supreme Court strikes down Trump’s global tariffs
item.description: WASHINGTON (Reuters) — The U.S. Supreme Court struck down Donald Trump's sweeping tariffs that he pursued under a law meant for use in national emergencies, handing the Republican president a stinging defeat in a landmark ruling on Friday with major implications for the global economy.
